# OpenSSL runtime notice

The Windows EXE bundles the unmodified OpenSSL DLLs supplied with CPython 3.14.4. Runtime reports OpenSSL 3.0.19 (27 Jan 2026). OpenSSL is maintained by the OpenSSL Project Authors and remains under Apache License 2.0, not the application's LRL-1.0.

License source: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/openssl/openssl/openssl-3.0/LICENSE.txt

Retrieved 2026-10-07. Unmodified LICENSE.txt SHA-256: `7d5450cb2d142651b8afa315b5f238efc805dad827d91ba367d8516bc9d49e7a`.

The desktop build also carries CPython's license (including its bundled component notices) and license files from the explicitly named installed dependency distributions. Build-time paths and user runtime data are not included in this notice.
